Diesel can be obtained by [[fractioning|Fractioning Tower]] [[light oil|Light Oil]] or [[naphtha|Naphtha]]. It is primarily used as a combustible fuel source, however it may also be [[cracked|Catalytic Cracking Tower]] for additional [[kerosene|Kerosene]] and [[petroleum gas|Petroleum Gas]].
